# Python.org

> The official home of Python programming language, providing downloads, documentation, community resources, and governance through the Python Software Foundation.

Python.org serves as the central hub for the Python programming language, offering official releases across multiple platforms, comprehensive documentation, and community engagement resources. The site is maintained by the Python Software Foundation and provides essential information for developers of all levels.

## Key Topics

- Python
- CPython
- Python Software Foundation
- Python releases
- Documentation
- Open-source
- Community
- Installation
- Release versions
- Platform support
- Getting started
- License
- Web frameworks
- GUI development
- Job board

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to Python.org](https://www.python.org): Official homepage of Python with releases, community events, and resources
- [About Python](https://www.python.org/about): About Python language, open-source nature, applications, and licensing
- [Download Python](https://www.python.org/downloads): Python download page with version support status and installation guides

## Documentation & Reference

- [3.14.3 Documentation](https://docs.python.org): Official Python 3.14.3 documentation with library and language references
- [History and License](https://docs.python.org/3/license.html): Python history from Guido van Rossum and licensing information

## Downloads by Platform

- [Python Releases for Windows](https://www.python.org/downloads/windows): Windows Python installers and embeddable packages for Python 3.13-3.14
- [Python Releases for macOS](https://www.python.org/downloads/macos): macOS Python installers and packages for Python 3.13 and 3.14
- [Python Source Releases](https://www.python.org/downloads/source): Python source code releases for versions 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14
- [Python Releases for Android](https://www.python.org/downloads/android): Android Python releases for mobile development on aarch64 and x86_64

## Community & Governance

- [Our Community](https://www.python.org/community): Python community overview with chat platforms, newsletters, and user groups
- [Python Software Foundation](https://www.python.org/psf): Python Software Foundation overview, grants, membership, and sponsorship info
